card.name: Words leading into warnings and do-not-use conditions
card.fires_on: Small words right before a warning or condition in label text, such as the colon after WARNING or PRECAUTIONS, and 'if' after 'Do not use'. Also words inside a stated condition, like 'oxygen' or 'see' in a do-not-use list.

modes.label: Colon after warning heading
modes.description: The colon after WARNING or PRECAUTIONS, just before the warning text.
modes.example: call a doctor or poison control center immediately. WARNING<<:>> Ingestion of more than 3

modes.label: The phrase 'Do not use if'
modes.description: The word 'if' or a condition word following 'Do not use' or 'not use a drug if'.
modes.example: brown, clear to slightly opalescent, and free of visible particulates. Do not use<< if>> the reconstituted solution is dis

modes.label: Inside a condition list
modes.description: A word within a list of conditions or contraindications, just before the item named.
modes.example: not use a drug if: - It is past the expiration date - You<< see>> small pieces floating in it - It

card.plain: It responds to the spot in a drug label where a warning or a 'do not use if' condition is about to be stated.
